newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nippon Steel shares rise in heavy trade.
newsitem.headline: Nippon Steel shares rise in heavy trade.

text.p: Shares in Nippon Steel Corp advanced in heavy trade on Monday morning, as the yen's recent weakening against the dollar helped brighten earnings prospects for producers of raw materials, market sources said.
At 0119 GMT, the share price was six yen higher at 365 on trading volume of 5.755 million shares, the heaviest on the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
"Investor demand is strong in raw materials issues, as well as high-techs. Buying in Nippon Steel gained momentum as it is a major issue in the sector," said a major securities' broker.
